ed1d94c6-57b9-4bc9-9ed5-5ba08be78317.name: Timeline Update
ed1d94c6-57b9-4bc9-9ed5-5ba08be78317.content:
You are updating the dev progress timeline at docs/dashboard-dev/Timeline.md. Your job is to add new entries based on recent git history.

Steps:

Read the current docs/dashboard-dev/Timeline.md to understand the format and find the last date covered.
Run git log --since="<last date in timeline>" --pretty=format:"%h %ad %s" --date=short --no-merges to get new commits.
If there are no new commits beyond what's already in the timeline, say so and stop.
For each new date that has commits, run git show <hash> --stat --format="%B" for every commit on that date to understand what changed.
Group commits by date. Within each date, merge related commits into a single bullet when they clearly belong together (e.g. a feature + its refactor on the same day).
Write each entry following this exact format:
## <Month Day, Year>
- **<Short bold title>**
  <Plain-language description of what was done and why. 1–3 sentences. Mention key files, APIs, or components only when they add clarity. No commit hashes.>

Rules:

Write in past tense, plain language — as if explaining to a stakeholder, not a machine.
Don't repeat information already in the timeline.
Don't add ticket references or status fields unless you find them in the commit messages.
Keep descriptions concise but specific — name the actual features, endpoints, components, or patterns involved.
Preserve all existing content in the file. Only append new date sections at the bottom.
